body: [opus 5.5] Verified 2026-10-13 09:55Z on devbig014, voice stack rebuilt on the private draft stack including the bridge close-once fix (draft D124878004) and the DGW interrupt routing (D121750125): scripts/voice-read-acceptance.py's same-socket interrupted re-answer gate passed 2 of 2 fresh-session trials: one interrupt each, the cut origin turn (3) followed by a complete follow-up answer (turn 4) on the same socket, follow-up coverage 1.00 and origin coverage 0.09.
